name: Inaho Shin
source:
A recurring character in each game in the Memories Off series. As a supporting character, Shin is good at understanding the protagonists, entertaining his surroundings and commenting on the events in the story. His appearance can vary each game.

His role in 1st:

Memories Off: [url=/c7877]Tomoya[/url]'s best friend and classmate. A self-proclaimed "Free man". 
[spoiler]Shin had witnessed the car accident in which [url=/c7878]Ayaka[/url] was killed, he regrets that he wasn't able to do anything at that time.[/spoiler]

[Translated from the [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off%E3%82%B7%E3%83%AA%E3%83%BC%E3%82%BA%E3%81%AE%E7%99%BB%E5%A0%B4%E4%BA%BA%E7%89%A9#Memories_Off.E5.88.9D.E5.87.BA]Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
